EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your Interest in Intel® Premier Support
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We appreciate your interest in Intel® Premier Support.
However, upon review of your application we regret to inform you that your request of Intel Premier Support for FPGAs access has been declined.
Some reasons for denial may include:
Application does not meet the company validation criteria. The request of Intel Premier Support access does not allow for the use of personal emails. The request needs to be submitted with your company’s e-mail address.
Alternative FPGA technical support path:
Access FPGA sign-in here Access Intel Communities here and Guidance here
If you feel your request was denied in error, contact Customer Support here
Please DO NOT reply to this e-mail message. This is an automated response.
To ensure that you continue receiving our e-mails, please add us to your address book.
